title: Senior Backend Developer - C# 100% (f/m/d) (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start until 31.08.2027, possible extension)

titleByLocale.en: Senior Backend Developer - C# 100% (f/m/d) (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start until 31.08.2027, possible extension)

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Senior Software Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the structured product platform by delivering high-quality, scalable solutions in a collaborative global environment. With a strong focus on backend development using C# and modern technologies, the role demands excellent problem-solving abilities, a client-centric mindset, and the capability to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven settings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Develop and maintain the structured product platform using modern backend technologies and scalable architectures

• Gather and analyse new business requirements, design robust and innovative backend solutions, and implement them efficiently

• Provide technical support and collaboration to business teams and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed higher education in Computer Science or a related technical field

• 10 years of professional software development experience, including 5+ years focused on backend development

• Strong hands-on expertise in C#; additional experience with TypeScript considered beneficial

• Solid understanding and practical experience with MongoDB, MS SQL, and Elasticsearch

• Familiarity with message brokers and communication protocols such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, gRPC, and GraphQL

• Proven ability to conduct effective code reviews with a strong commitment to high code quality

• Self-reliant worker, capable of delivering independently while also collaborating effectively within global teams

• Consistently delivers with a client-centric mindset across all tasks and projects

• Quick learner who remains productive and solution-focused under pressure and tight deadlines

• Team-oriented with a collaborative and supportive working style

• Fluent in English, enabling clear and efficient communication

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients and is a premium brand in global wealth management.
We are searching for an experienced, reliable and organized personality to support the leadership team of the Group CFO. Starting date is as soon as possible.

YOUR CHALLENGE
• Provide administrative support to direct reports of the Group CFO, acting as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders at all levels and external counterparts, demonstrating discretion, professionalism, and strong communication skills
• Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings, global travel arrangements, and prepare expense reports with precision
• Plan and manage business trips including travel planning such as flights, hotels, and transfers
• Prepare and process detailed expense reports accurately and in a timely manner, maintaining audit readiness
• Organize internal and external meetings and events, conferences, and team workshops, covering all logistical aspects
• Proactively support preparation for meetings, anticipating needs in advance with appropriate research
• Independently handle ad-hoc tasks, including small project coordination and HR-related administrative support
• Ensure smooth day-to-day office operations, managing correspondence, calls, and requests with tact and diplomacy
• Opportunity to gain broader insights across the Finance unit by providing coordinated administrative support to direct reports of the Group CFO, ensuring efficiency

YOUR PROFILE
• Discreet and trustworthy individual with absolute dedication to confidentiality
• Minimum 3-4 years’ experience as EA/PA, ideally in finance or corporate environment
• Team-oriented and solution-focused with excellent problem-solving abilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
• Strong time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work
• Highly organised, proactive, and able to operate reliably under pressure with minimal supervision, with strong attention to detail
• Proficient user in MS Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.
